scope: development measurement only; no proof/security/official verification claim
hash_scope: explicit --source files and command executable only; scripts/dynamic libraries/build closure must be added explicitly
warmup_policy: none; each repeat is a fresh process; OS/page caches are not cleared

runs.rss_scope: wait4 high water and sampled sum across own process group; not cgroup peak
runs.cpu_scope: wait4 child accounting, including descendants the child waited for
